instance_already_running: An Auto-clicker instance is already running.
theme_tip: Toggle between dark and light theme
hold_enable_tip: When disabled, the trigger button no longer fires clicks.
trigger_tip: Mouse button to hold to start clicking.
cps_tip: Target rate. Slider covers 1-50, field up to 200.
hold_jitter_tip:
Random variation (±) applied to the interval between clicks.
0 = perfectly regular rate.
auto_enable_tip: Starts auto-click. Resets the session counter.
press_tip: Delay between press and release. Some apps ignore overly fast clicks.
auto_jitter_tip: Random variation (±) applied to BOTH interval AND click duration.
limit_tip: Stops auto mode after N clicks. 0 = unlimited.
use_positions_tip: If enabled, cursor is moved to each position before clicking.
positions_intro: List of positions cycled through in auto mode (if enabled).
btn_add_delayed_tip: Gives 3 seconds to position the cursor, then captures.
hk_toggle_tip: Toggles auto mode on/off. Works without focus.
hk_momentary_tip: Auto mode runs while the combination is held.
notify_tip: Uses notify-send (Linux). Silent if not installed.
caveat_wayland_hotkeys: Wayland blocks global keyboard hotkeys for security reasons. Shortcuts will not fire when other apps are focused. Switch to an X11 session for full functionality.
caveat_macos_accessibility: macOS requires Accessibility permission for global input. Grant it under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility, then restart the app.
caveat_unknown_display: Unknown display server. Global hotkeys may not work.
language_tip: Changes interface language. The UI is rebuilt on change.
test_intro:
Click anywhere on the screen to identify the button.
Useful for spotting side buttons 8 / 9 of a mouse.
capture_prompt:
Press the desired combination
(Esc to cancel)
notif_limit: {n, plural, one {Limit reached ({n_fmt} click)} other {Limit reached ({n_fmt} clicks)}}
